source_fragments.fragment: How should the drawn mesh’s smaller enclosed volume change the billed lift basis?
What measured membrane shape would settle this sign change on the same safety factor and material basis?

Rendering segments are not physical member counts.
This budget prices the first-generation hull of many permanently sealed vacuum cells; it has not been re-priced for the current one film on hoop rings over a two-walled truss.
